notes.title: 📢 Aebal is Back — and Getting a Full Revival in Unity!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

I'm excited to officially announce that Aebal, an indie game project originally started back in 2021, is being revived! After some time away, the passion for this game and its story never really left—and now, development is restarting stronger than ever.

This time, Aebal is being fully rewritten and remade in Unity for better performance, more polish, and a fresh take on the original vision. Think of this as a rebirth—not just a reboot.


I want Aebal: Recoded to grow into something truly memorable, and your feedback is a huge part of that. If you’ve played it before, watched the project, or you’re just curious, please take a moment to fill out this quick Google Form:

👉 https://forms.gle/2bcNoY844edsk7NS9

Tell me what you liked, what you didn’t, and what you'd love to see next.

Thank you for supporting Aebal—from the first spark to this new chapter. Let’s make something great together. 🖤

– Mono x Mellow

notes.title: October Update!
notes.content:
[h1]This is a biggie[/h1]
[h3]1. Redid song detection system, songs are preprocessed and enemies are spawned before song
2. Redid entire pattern spawning systems, much more customizable and dynamic
3. Added separate music and SFX sliders
4. More options [including fancier trails and other graphics settings]
5. Several FPS improvements[/h3]

notes.title: Known bug for German Players/Bekannter Bug für deutsche Spieler
notes.content:
Over the past few weeks, we've noticed a bug in Aebal that effects German platforms exclusively. We are actively trying to find the source of this bug and will keep everyone updated on the status. We do apologize in advance. 

In den letzten Wochen haben wir einen Fehler in Aebal festgestellt, der ausschließlich deutsche Plattformen betrifft. Wir versuchen aktiv, die Quelle dieses Fehlers zu finden und werden alle über den Status auf dem Laufenden halten. Wir entschuldigen uns im Voraus.

notes.title: Epic update
notes.content: I (think) I've fixed the display resolution related bugs, fixed some random stuff, improved FPS, etc. Have fun and make sure to leave feedback and report any bugs you come across!
